tasks.short: Read the blueprint and measure on site, calculate offsets and lengths, mark routes and supports, and record the as-built route.

steps.what: Plumber reads the blueprints and takes measurements on site
Plumber calculates offsets, angles and pipe lengths by hand
Plumber lays out full scale drawings of pipe systems and supports on walls and floors
Plumber sketches the as-built route on paper for the office

tasks.design: A pipe calculator on the fitter's tablet ({OTHER}) gives offsets and cut lengths from entered measurements. The as-built route is marked up on the drawing in the same app with photos, so the office gets it for the quality file without a paper sketch. Measuring and marking out stay with the plumber.
tasks.previous_blocker: Offsets were worked out by hand and as-built routes sketched on paper.
tasks.enabler_now: Tablet apps calculate pipe offsets and mark up drawings with photos.
tasks.still_hard: Walls are never where the drawing says; measuring stays on site.
tasks.human_edge: Seeing that the route on paper hits a beam that is not on the drawing.

evidence.claim: Tablet apps calculate pipe offsets and let fitters mark up drawings with photos.
Under the Wkb the contractor and a quality assurer build the file submitted at completion.

assumptions: Boundary: from blueprint to as-built record; installing the pipe is outside.
Input contract: blueprints from the designer; drawings shared by the office in the app; fallback is paper.
Measuring and marking out do not change.
research_questions: Are as-built records complete at handover?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Most of this task is measuring and marking on site.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Survey the site, plan route and order of work, make the material list, order materials and agree timing with client and trades.

steps.what: Plumber surveys the site and existing pipes
Plumber plans the pipe system layout and order of installation
Plumber writes the material list from the plan
Plumber phones the wholesaler to order materials
Plumber agrees timing with the client and other trades

tasks.design: The installer's ERP ({ERP}) builds a priced material list from the job calculation using the sector's product and price data; the plumber checks and adjusts it on the tablet, and only then is the order sent electronically to the wholesaler. Surveying, planning and agreeing timing stay with the plumber.
tasks.previous_blocker: Material lists were written by hand and phoned through.
tasks.enabler_now: Installer software connects to the sector's product and price data and sends orders electronically.
tasks.still_hard: Repairs reveal surprises; lists made before opening the wall are often wrong.
tasks.human_edge: Choosing a route that a future plumber can still reach.

reach.learn: Whether electronic orders cut wrong deliveries.

evidence.claim: 2BA is a product and price data hub for the Dutch installation sector that installer software connects to.
Syntess Atrium supports material ordering and call-off for installation firms.

assumptions: Boundary: from survey to agreed timing and ordered materials; installation is outside.
Input contract: job specifications from the office; product and price data from the sector data hub; fallback is phone orders.
Surveying, planning and timing do not change.
Purchasing clerk time is outside the plumber's savings.
research_questions: Do wrong or missing materials fall?

already_counted.description: Plumber checks and adjusts the generated list.

incremental.description: Plumber enters the job calculation in the ERP.

approvals.approved_version: The material list as checked by the plumber in s3; changes need a new check before ordering.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Most of this task is surveying and planning.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Study drawings and specs, look up rules in the standards, ask the designer about unclear details and note decisions on the drawing.

steps.what: Plumber reviews blueprints and specifications to determine work details
Plumber looks up building codes and standards for water, gas and drainage

loop.input: The plumber's question and the standards and building rules the firm is licensed to use.
loop.output: An answer quoting the relevant clause with standard number, clause number and edition.
loop.check: Code checks the quoted clause matches the licensed text word for word and comes from the edition in force; the plumber reads the clause before acting.
loop.stop: One answer per question; no matching clause means 'not found' and the plumber asks the designer.
loop.why_not_simpler: Fitters ask in site language; clause search by number assumes they know where to look.

steps.what: Plumber phones the site manager or designer about unclear details
Plumber notes the decisions on the paper drawing

tasks.design: For code questions, a bounded step answers only by quoting the clause from the standards and building rules the firm is licensed to use, with clause and edition, and the plumber reads the clause. Decisions are marked on the shared drawing in the tablet app ({OTHER}) so the office and site manager see them. Studying drawings and asking the designer stay with the plumber.
tasks.previous_blocker: Standards sat in binders or a viewer that needs the right clause number.
tasks.enabler_now: Licensed standards are available in online viewers, and language models can match a question to a clause.
tasks.still_hard: Standards are copyrighted; the tool may only use texts the firm has licensed.
tasks.human_edge: Knowing when a drawing is wrong, not just unclear.

reach.learn: Whether quoted clauses help apprentices learn.

evidence.claim: Licensed standards are available to firms in online viewers.
Dutch building rules refer to national standards for water, gas and drainage installations; the texts are copyrighted.

assumptions: Boundary: from drawings to annotated decisions; design changes are outside.
Input contract: blueprints and specifications from the designer; licensed standards bought by the firm; fallback is the binder.
Studying drawings and asking the designer do not change.
Designer time is outside the plumber's savings.
research_questions: How often does the quoted clause settle the question?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Most of this task is reading drawings.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Read the spec, size pipes, choose pipe type, supports and fittings, look up article numbers and check van stock.

steps.what: Plumber reads specifications for pressure, medium and temperature
Plumber calculates pipe sizes from flow tables
Plumber selects pipe types, supports, hangers and fittings according to specifications
Plumber looks up article numbers in the wholesaler catalogue
Plumber checks stock in the van

tasks.design: A sizing calculator in the installer software ({ERP}) computes pipe sizes from flow, pressure and length using the standard tables, and the plumber checks the result. Chosen materials map to article numbers from the sector's product data without catalogue searches. Reading specs, choosing materials and checking the van stay with the plumber.
tasks.previous_blocker: Sizes came from printed flow tables and article numbers from catalogues.
tasks.enabler_now: Installer software has sizing tools and the sector's product data.
tasks.still_hard: Existing pipes and odd situations need judgement beyond the tables.
tasks.human_edge: Choosing a support that will not rattle in a bedroom wall.

reach.learn: Whether site sizing agrees with design sizing.

evidence.claim: 2BA is a product and price data hub for the Dutch installation sector that installer software connects to.
Drinking water installations must be sized to the national standard.

assumptions: Boundary: from specifications to van stock checked; ordering is outside.
Input contract: specifications from the designer; product data from the sector data hub; fallback is printed tables.
Reading specs and choosing materials do not change.
Van stock is not tracked in this design.
research_questions: Do sizing errors found at inspection fall?
tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The plumber keeps measuring, planning, choosing and fitting; hand calculations, catalogues and phone orders shrink.
skills_to_grow: Marking up drawings on a tablet
role.ambitious_version: A plumber whose drawings, materials and records are ready before the van leaves.
